issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares a parameterless method +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (line 70), and the template indicates students should implement that method (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java TODO at line 12). The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) instead defines public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) (signature at line 75). This parameter-list difference changes the required API and will confuse students and/or cause tests that expect a no-argument getTotalNumberOfStudents() to fail or not compile against the solution's signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the specification: implement a parameterless method public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() that returns the total number of students (inscribed + guest) as described in the UML. If the boolean option to include/exclude guest students is desired for extra functionality, add an overloaded method public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) but keep the no-argument version so the public API matches the problem statement and existing tests. Update the solution file at src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java accordingly and, if necessary, document the overload in the problem statement or tests.
